span.label: mechanisms
span.term: A WIDELY USED REGION NAME IS REPORTED TO HAVE NO COHERENT DEFINITION, AND THE COST IS NAMED: despite the popularity of the animal for studying the region there is LITTLE CONSENSUS ON A COHERENT ANATOMICAL DEFINITION, WHICH IS PROBLEMATIC BECAUSE IT COMPLICATES THE INTERPRETATION OF THE WEALTH OF NEW DATA. The missing definition is treated as a defect in the literature's ability to read its own results
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THE PARTS THAT ARE ILL-DEFINED ARE ENUMERATED RATHER THAN GESTURED AT: what remains ILL-DEFINED is named as the BOUNDARIES which distinguish it from neighbouring areas, its LAMINAR ORGANIZATION and its CHEMOARCHITECTURAL PROFILE - three specific things, each of which a definition would have to fix
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: IN THE ABSENCE OF A DEFINITION, PRACTICE SUBSTITUTES TWO PROXIES, AND BOTH ARE NAMED: targeting has relied EITHER on functional mapping of the areas around the region OR on stereotactic coordinates followed by POST-HOC HISTOLOGICAL COMPARISON to one of SEVERAL REFERENCE ATLASES. Where the definition is missing, the coordinates and the atlas stand in for it
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: AND THE PROXIES ARE CONSISTENT WITHIN A STUDY AND INCOMPARABLE ACROSS STUDIES, FOR A STATED REASON: these conventions MAY YIELD CONSISTENT RECORDING LOCATIONS WITHIN A STUDY, BUT HAMPER THE COMPARISON of the region ACROSS STUDIES, SINCE THEY ARE BASED ON DIFFERENT LABELING METHODOLOGIES AND UNRELATED NOMENCLATURES. Reliability inside a lab and incommensurability between labs, traced to the naming systems themselves
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THE CONTRIBUTION IS EXPLICITLY A RECONCILIATION OF NOMENCLATURES, NOT A NEW FINDING: the paper states that it RECONCILED WIDELY USED BUT DISPARATE NOMENCLATURES referring to the region VERSUS the areas around it - two naming systems, each with its own literature, mapped onto one another
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THE NEW DEFINITION IS ASSEMBLED FROM FOUR INDEPENDENT KINDS OF EVIDENCE, AND THE LIST IS THE DEFINITION: the combined approaches are said to provide A COHERENT DEFINITION that INCORPORATES laminar architecture, extrastriate projections, thalamic connections and cortico-cortical connections. Nothing here is a criterion on its own; the definition is the conjunction
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THE DEFINING CRITERIA ARE STAINS - THE DEFINITION IS OPERATIONALISED BY REAGENTS: the region is delineated using CYTOARCHITECTURAL AND LAMINAR CRITERIA obtained from Nissl-, parvalbumin- and type-2 muscarinic acetylcholine receptor-immunostained sections. What the term picks out is fixed by what three stains show
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: AND ONE STATED AIM IS THAT THE CRITERIA BE AVAILABLE TO EVERYONE: the study aims to provide A RESOURCE for identifying the region with anatomical criteria THAT ARE EVIDENT USING UBIQUITOUS STAINING METHODS, SUCH AS A NISSL STAIN. A definition is chosen partly for the commonness of the equipment needed to apply it
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: WHEN THE ANATOMY OFFERS NO LANDMARKS, FUNCTION IS BORROWED TO SERVE AS ONE: since the dorsal cortical surface in rodents LACKS GROSS ANATOMICAL LANDMARKS, the pattern of responses in the surrounding areas has provided INCREASINGLY-USED FUNCTIONAL LANDMARKS for locating higher visual and associative regions. A location is fixed by what a region DOES because there is nothing to see
span.note: about this quote: The span contains `increasinglyused` for `increasingly-used` - a LOST-HYPHEN FUSION, damage shape 10. A line-break hyphen was dropped by the extraction and the halves fused. The quote is an exact substring and anchors correctly; the damage is in what a reader of the tag sees. None of the four shapes test_damaged_quote_is_annotated.py looks for covers this, so it is annotated by hand.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: AND THE BORROWED METHOD CARRIES ITS OWN PRECONDITION, WHICH IS STATED: functional mapping of that kind is NOT FEASIBLE IN THE ABSENCE OF a broadly expressed calcium indicator or intrinsic optical imaging - so the substitute for the missing definition is itself unavailable to laboratories without those tools
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THE TWO NAMING SYSTEMS ARE FOUND TO OVERLAP PARTIALLY, NOT CLEANLY, AND THE PATTERN IS REPORTED PIECE BY PIECE: the anterior pole of the region DOES NOT OVERLAP with any of the neighbouring areas, the posterior sectors OVERLAP PARTLY with two of them, and its most lateral and posterior extent LARGELY OVERLAPPED with a third. Neither vocabulary's units nest inside the other's
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: A NAME IS SHOWN TO ASSERT SOMETHING ITS OWN EVIDENCE COMPLICATES: these areas ARE REFERRED TO AS EXTRASTRIATE, IMPLYING A PRIMACY OF VISUAL PROCESSING - THOUGH they OVERLAP CONSIDERABLY with a region the paper characterises as cognitive. The label's morphology makes a claim about what the territory is for, and the overlap is the counter-evidence
span.note: about this quote: TRIMMED, not re-sliced: the sentence continues "...navigational and movement-related functions that can be expressed independently of visual input", which is the sharper half of the point - but the bioRxiv WATERMARK is spliced into the citation list mid-sentence ("cognitive (Harvey et al., 2012; 14 bioRxiv preprint ... doi: a ; Morcos & Harvey, 2016"), so no contiguous span reaches it. The tag claims only what the quote carries.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Where associative, motor and sensory inputs are integrated synaptically inside PPC, and whether modality-specific topographies exist there, remain unmapped.
span.note: what this limits: any functional claim about integration in mouse PPC: IT REMAINS TO BE MAPPED MORE FULLY WHERE THE INPUTS FROM ASSOCIATIVE, MOTOR, AND SENSORY AREAS ARE INTEGRATED SYNAPTICALLY WITHIN PPC, AND WHETHER GRADED TOPOGRAPHIES EXIST FOR DIFFERENT SENSORY MODALITIES
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The mapping was done only against extrastriate visual projections; equivalent mapping against somatosensory, auditory or motor inputs was not performed.
span.note: what this limits: the reference frame the mapping used: THE PRESENT STUDY FOCUSED ON CHARACTERIZING PPC RELATIVE TO EXTRASTRIATE PROJECTIONS, and comparable mapping against somatosensory, auditory or motor inputs was not done
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Antibody cross-reactivity between M2-receptor staining and BDA tracer labelling was observed and had to be controlled for post hoc.
span.note: what this limits: the M2-receptor labelling in BDA-injected tissue: WE NOTED CROSS-REACTIVITY BETWEEN ANTIBODIES AGAINST M2-RECEPTORS AND BDA LABELING, controlled by comparison with tissue WITHOUT BDA INJ[ection]
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Existing targeting strategies are consistent inside a study and incomparable between studies.
span.note: what this limits: any comparison of PPC results across laboratories: the authors state that existing strategies may yield consistent recording locations within a study but hamper comparison across studies, because they rest on different labeling methodologies and unrelated nomenclatures
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The boundaries that distinguish the area from its neighbours are stated to remain ill-defined.
span.note: what this limits: any claim about the extent of mouse PPC: the boundaries distinguishing it from neighbouring areas, its laminar organization and its chemoarchitectural profile are said to remain ill-defined
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The criteria for defining the area are stated not to have been established before this paper.
span.note: what this limits: any use of mouse PPC as a defined region before 2018: the authors state that the laminar, cytoarchitectonic and chemoarchitectonic criteria they describe have not, to their knowledge, been established previously
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the MAChR2 labelling pattern was checked against staining in other sections after cross-reactivity was noticed between the M2 antibody and the BDA tracer
span.note: eliminates: that the labelling attributed to M2 receptors is the tracer showing through - a known cross-reactivity, noticed and then bounded rather than ignored

span.label: mouse PPC - A REGION IN ROUTINE USE WITHOUT ESTABLISHED CRITERIA: the boundaries distinguishing it from neighbouring areas are said to remain ill-defined, and the criteria this paper supplies are said not to have been established previously, so experiments had been targeting a region whose extent each laboratory fixed for itself
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: comparability, here - PRESENT WITHIN A STUDY AND ABSENT ACROSS THEM: the same targeting strategies give consistent recording locations inside one study while hampering comparison between studies, because the studies rest on different labeling methodologies and unrelated nomenclatures - so a PPC result is reproducible where it was made and unjoinable elsewhere
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the delineation - THREE STAINS AND A LAMINAR READING: PPC is delineated using cytoarchitectural and laminar criteria from Nissl, parvalbumin and M2 muscarinic receptor immunostaining, so the region's extent is defined by what those particular stains show
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Medial PPC is marked out from its neighbours by a drop in parvalbumin staining in both cell bodies and neuropil, against dense PV staining in adjacent retrosplenial and somatosensory cortex.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A sharp fall in M2 muscarinic acetylcholine receptor staining in superficial layers marks the border between agranular retrosplenial cortex and medial PPC.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Because V2M closely resembles PPC in Nissl and staining terms, the appearance of primary visual cortex is the most reliable sign that a coronal section lies caudal to all PPC subdivisions.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The anterior pole of PPC overlaps no extrastriate area, its posterior sectors overlap areas A and AM, and its most lateral-posterior part PtP overlaps largely with area RL - reconciling the Paxinos-Franklin parietal nomenclature with the Montero/Wang-Burkhalter extrastriate one.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: At -1.91mm from bregma all labelled fibres of extrastriate area A fall inside lateral PPC, with no extrastriate label in medial PPC.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Anterograde injections confined to PPC label the associative thalamic nuclei LP, Po and, more anteriorly, LD.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: PPC thalamic output was specific to associative nuclei, sparing the adjacent primary relay nuclei DLG (visual) and VPM (somatosensory).
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Parietal output to frontal cortex is coarsely topographic: medial PPC projects to cingulate cortex and lateral PPC to secondary motor cortex.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Monosynaptic rabies tracing showed PPC receives input from every cortical area to which it sends anterograde label, so all these cortical connections are reciprocal.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: PPC's densest cortical projections go to extrastriate areas AM/V2M and AL/V2L, with AM/V2M showing a medial-to-lateral topography matching the injection sites and AL/V2L sometimes showing a mirrored order.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: V1 projects most strongly to the lateromedial field immediately lateral to it and to the laterointermediate field beyond that.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
